title: Review - Feature idea
body: I’ve been using this app for a while and I love the features it has and everything is great, the only thing I would love to have is to see the timer when I have my phone locked as notification. I have seen this feature in other apps and I think it’s great and it would enhance the timer since I don’t have to open the app and go to the timer I would just look at my phone and see how much time is left.

title: I cannot find a way to sync between devices
body:
Hello,

Why is this app not syncing data between devices. I have even created a web account (which was by the way as painful as finding the sync option) but apps on iPhone and iOS act as 2 separate not related apps. Is there a way how to sync this app?
